name: Bánh ướt lòng gà
summary: White, soft, chewy rice sheets with shredded chicken, breast bone, thigh, offal, and trứng non. The fish sauce is not overly salty, and chili is there if you want heat.
origin: A Da Lat plate of long standing: chicken on the sheets, rather than the pork-cake plate.
texture: The sheets are white, soft, and chewy.
howToEat: The plate is shredded chicken, breast bone, thigh, offal, and trứng non, not chả lụa, nem chua, nem nướng, or chả quế.
Fish sauce is on the plate. It is not overly salty, and chili is there if you want heat.
where: Quán Long, hẻm 202, lô A16 KQH Phan Đình Phùng. Bánh ướt lòng gà Đà Lạt (Hằng), 68 Phan Đình Phùng, which also sells bột chiên, xắp xắp, and bánh bèo. Quán Chip Chip, 28 Tăng Bạt Hổ. Quán Trang, 15F Tăng Bạt Hổ.
priceBand: Visit Lâm Đồng prints 30,000 to above 45,000 VND at Long, 27,000–35,000 VND at Hằng, 25,000–100,000 VND at Chip Chip, and 35,000–45,000 VND at Trang. The figures are not averaged.
